The value for the `-bufsize` flag of FFmpeg. Should be used in conjunction with the encoding max rate flag. With the VP8, VP9 and AV1 codecs, a video bitrate must also be set.

## CLI flag

Use `--buffer-size` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--buffer-size <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--buffer-size <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--buffer-size <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--buffer-size <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--buffer-size <value>` |
